note: Per-champion CLONED voice pack (tasks #27 fallback rung 2, #184 separation, #142). EMPTY ON PURPOSE — this file is the drop-in contract, written ahead of the audio so the client half needs no further change when clips land. The client (apps/client/src/audio/selectVoiceLadder.ts) reads ONLY lines.select[].clip; every other field is provenance/QA carried for the report surfaces. An empty champions map, a missing champion, a missing category and a 404 on this whole file all mean the same thing to the ladder: skip rung 2 and fall through to the name/quote rungs, which cover 113/113. Lives under content/assets/ (NOT content/config/) for the same reason the names and quotes packs do — it is a generated asset pack validated by the client's tolerant parser plus selectVoiceLadder.test.ts, not a hand-authored binding for the content schema. Writing this file is the WHOLE integration: no packages/shared schema change, no content:validate change, no client change.
generator: tools/voice-gen — synth.py renders the clips + .method sidecars; the indexer that folds those sidecars into this file is the last unwritten step and belongs to that lane.
